por_que: Partially covers three HRP risks: neuro-ocular syndrome (vision), sensorimotor and vestibular function (nausea and dizziness, relevant on days 1 to 3) and altered immune response (rash).
referencia_en_vuelo: Space motion sickness usually subsides in 2 or 3 days.
cuando_avisar: Context rule: headache with cabin CO2 above 3 mmHg (one-hour average) generates an environment alert.
prevencion: Ventilation and scrubbing of cabin CO2: keep its 7-day average below 2.5 mmHg and avoid peaks above 3 mmHg.
fuentes: NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
